Case studies

Three engagements, with the numbers the clients agreed to publish.

Packaging manufacturer, Ohio: four points of gross margin

Product-line profitability showed a fifth of the catalogue losing money. Repricing, two discontinued lines and procurement on resin and corrugate delivered 4.2 points of gross margin in eleven months.

Food processor, Ontario: 18 percent more throughput

Changeover time on the two main lines fell from 74 to 31 minutes; schedule adherence rose from 61 to 92 percent. No capital was spent.

Building products, Pennsylvania: two companies, one operating model

After an acquisition, a 100-day integration merged two ERPs, two sales teams and two price lists, and delivered the deal model's synergies in the first year.
